note: Pass lines fixed BEFORE any phone measurement (2026-11-01, 08). 'source' names the project document a number comes from; 'assumption': true marks numbers with no project source (08's proposal, to be confirmed by 01/02/04). Tier is chosen from /proc/meminfo MemTotal unless -Tier is given. A criterion applies to the listed scenes; the worst value over those scenes is judged. Scenes whose args were not applied by the game are never judged.
